lines.t: [Ethereal piano and soft, rhythmic staccato strings]
[Atmospheric and cinematic]
I’m looking for the light when the sun goes down
Searching for a kingdom that’s not of this ground
Every heartbeat’s a whisper, a call to the sky
I’m lifting up my worries, I’m letting ‘em fly
Oh, I’m letting ‘em fly...
[Chorus: Melodic Male Vocals]
We pray for the fire, we pray for the rain
We find all the beauty inside of the pain
From the dust to the stars, every breath is a seed
You’re the King of the garden, you’re all that I need.
[Verse 2: Female Rap - ]
Yeah, look—
Walkin' through the valley where the shadows like to play
I don’t lean on my own vision, I just listen when I pray
It’s a narrow conversation, heavy weight up on the soul
But I’m trading in my pieces just to let Him make me whole
I see the fingerprints of Heaven all across this place
Hard pressed but not crushed, that’s the promise that I keep
While the world is fast asleep, I’m divin' in the deep.
[Verse 3: Female Rap -]
It’s a different kind of hunger, it’s a different kind of thirst
When you realize the Last is gonna be the one who’s First
Keep my armor polished and my spirit on the line
Everything I’m building is Yours, it was never mine
I’m knocking on the Heavens till He opens up the door
No weapon formed against me is ever gonna stand
I’m a daughter of the King, I’m held within His hand.
[Bridge: Male and Female Duet]
[Cinematic build-up, epic strings]
(Male): It’s not a shadow, it’s a canopy
(Female): Your mercy is the only thing that’s guiding me
(Male): Through the fire, through the flood, through the night
(Both): I’m walking by my faith and not by sight!
[Final Chorus: Melodic Male Vocals]
We pray for the fire, we pray for the rain
We find all the beauty inside of the pain
From the dust to the stars, every breath is a seed
You’re the King of the garden, you’re all that I need.
